item.title: Session 28
item.description:
Flash back to when Eldil was teleported by the hag to Manuil's last known location.
Eldil appears in a darkly lit room and hears Manuil talking to someone: "This is it, this is how we get in, this is how we accomplish our mission." He also mention's Karsus.
Eldil approaches and says "probably weren't expecting me now brother." Eldil falls on his face, the hag laughs and an illusion fades away. It was a hag trick,
The area is muddy, swampy and stinks, sounds of children's whispers. it is underground. there are three corridors leading outside of the large room he is in. The hag offers to teleport him back for a cost or just leave him there. Eldil tries to cast bane on the hag but it fails. He tries to attack her with his weapon instead. The pact that Eldil made with the Hag makes it so he can't attack her.
Eldil agrees to bring Jaden to the Hag in order for her to return him to the party. if he fails his soul is forfeit.
Eldil appears back at the ass place in the morning, to the surprise of the rest of party. Eldil tells the party that he made a deal with the Hag and has her mark now and that she wants Jaden in exchange for Eldil's soul.
Jaden still struggles with the idea of poisoning Dryz,
Jaden gives an impassioned speech to the party, saying he admires the rest of the party, he admits he is a shape changer and steals peoples identities and lives as them, he tried to do good but he realizes it's not enough and offers to take Netties poison.
The Hag chimes in and tells us she wants Jaden and he's been lying to us. the party doesn't care and tells Jaden he is a welcome member of the party.
Eldil describes the location he was teleported to, Jaden remembers a swamp which might be where Eldil was taken.
The party heads to the Iron accord archives to try and find information on how to kill a hag. They find Thomas Aquinous who works for the Iron accord. Thomas tells them they have a book fromBaldur’s Gate that has to do with Hags, it's called Hansel and Gretel and is kind of like the Jeremy Renner movie "Hansel and Gretel: Witch Hunters".
In the book, they had to take an Anathema which is the Hag's most hated thing and use it in a ritual before killing the hag. the ritual makes the Hag mortal for a period of time. The ritual needs to be completed by a ritual caster. Requires a ritual circle drawn with resources that have an affinity to the Hag with the anathema held in the center.
Thomas gathers the party's testimony so he can have the Iron accord investigate a Hag being on Ardezax.
Eldil asks why Bow is wanted, he says he doesn't know slightly deceptively, Eldil casts hold person, Grimgil takes his letter and demands Bow shares his secrets. insulted Bow refuses to share.
The party heads to see Darius Veynar and have him teleport us to Bruxar. he gives us a letter to give once we arrive to Bruxar, it is to inform that we are carrying horses to the King's guard. Bow and Grimgil transform into horses so they don't look out of place. Once teleported they hand the letter to the guard, they let them pass. The party is now in Bruxar. Jaden leads the rest of the part around Bruxar. they drop off they're extra horse to the Crown's guard.
Dryz approaches a guard and tries to bring up the Hag subtly to see if they have any reaction while having detect thoughts active, but they don't at all.
The party heads shopping to get some clothes and disguises for Bow and Grimgil, Jaden changes his appearances. They then head to a library.
In the library they look to do more research, but get turned away. and head to Bruxar's chapter of the Gilded Fangs.
As they are heading to the Gilded Fang's Old mother Salt shows Eldil a quick map of where to find her, between Springvale and Oakhurst.
As they are heading to a different section of the city, a guard recognized Bow and stops the party. Dryz uses a subtle suggestion to have the guard let them pass and they are allowed through.
Because Bow is wanted Grimgil stays with him at an inn away from the Gilded Fang's. the rest of the party go to the Gilded Fang. Dryz enters and talks to an Orc, Jaden activates his detect thoughts, while Dryz describes the Hag in Detail. they don't find any more details on the Hag's weakness.
The party decides to head towards the Hag's lair and set's up camp a little bit outside of town.
During his watch, Grimgil notices the poors trying to attack the party roll for initiative.

item.title: Session 27
item.description:
The party loots the sewers and find 1700 GP, Elvarel Nythorne's journal, and the following items: Quaal's Feather Token, Anchor Spellwrought Tattoo (3rd Level) Selesnya Guild Signet Ring of Warmth
The party looks for Tessa's remains and finds some cloth that belonged to her, they grab some of it as proof to bring to the ships crew
Eldil cuts off some of the Hydra's heads, Dryz tries to recover some tadpoles from the heads he manages to recover a total of 6 tadpoles.
The party heads out of the sewer into the town, it looks a little worse than it was. There is a sorrow-ness in the air as everyone realizes all the people they forgot were missing. They head to Darius Veynar of the Crowns guard to seek a reward for the false hydra heads. Darius Veynar greets them and brings them inside to discuss. The party tells Darius everything they know about the False Hydra, the still missing kids and the witch and the possible links between them. He tells the party about some concerning news regarding the king of Ardezax, Aldric Stormborn, he's becoming more tyranical and call's himself Navadjimon. He shows the party an image of bow telling us he is wanted dead by the king.
Jaden says he knows a good advisor to the king named Marquet, Darius Veynar says he was a good up and coming advisor.
Grimgil asks if any of the children were switcheroo'd like in Bow's vision, the only info he has is that some of the kidnappings had salt at the scene
Elvarel Nythorne was a historian with some renown on Ardezax.
Darius Veynar asks Dryz and the party to stay around and help stabilize the city, and by proxy the continent itself. mentions that Dryz parents have not been seen in a while. He also suggest we travel by foot or horse because Bow is wanted.
Dryz drops by the Valient Amber to deliver Tessa's clothes and inform them that she is dead.
Eldil makes a minor illusion of Manuil, since Jaden asks Darius if he's seen him.
The party heads to bed, Jaden remembers there are conditions to killing a hag, he is not sure what those are but it's not as straight forward as just killing it.
Eldil is on first watch, he hears water drips and smells a swamp even though there's no rain outside. he believes it's the hag, there's a long black hair. "now, now deary, don't be hasty. I overheard a few things earlier, looking for someone, I might know a few things for a price, hmm family related who knows" Eldil responds that he is looking for someone. "Well we wouldn't want to wake your friends, just step outside and perhaps we can have a trade". she offers to take some of eldil's blood for information on Manuil. Eldil chooses to step outside, but trips Grimgil's alarm, he tell the party is just going to pee, but Grimgil is suspicious. The hag keeps talking to Eldil "I'll give you a price, but first ask" Eldil says he wants transportation to Manuil. "Now.... that's it, the only information is that their new cults raising around and his name seems to be gaining in popularity, she's vague about his whereabouts". Eldil senses she is telling the truth and says the price is only a little blood. Eldil accepts, she extracts some of his blood from his neck.
Grimgil thinks this is taking a long time and reaches out to Eldil, he dismisses him, Grimgil looks for Eldil outside and starts to approach, The hag transports Eldil somewhere. Grimgil goes outside looking for Eldil and only finds the smell of salt. He goes back inside and informs the rest of the party, they conclude that Eldil was taken, but Grimgil knows he lied about peeing.
The party heads to bed determined to find Eldil in the morning. During Dryz's watch he hurls insults and threats at the hag through the mirror. She responds "This is what you asked for, eat us". Dryz's panicked at losing someone else, eats all six tadpoles trying to harness their power to get to eldil, but nothing happens yet.
Jaden has a dream of a figure, he knows it is a mimicry of something that doesn't understand nature, "The beast obey you" a bunch of weird animals appear. "We offer you true tongue of the wild". the druid touches his chest: "Take root .... I am groot". it's tadpole related. he wakes up and and there is the smell of wet moss, and has dirty fingernails. he gains a new power.
During Grimgil's watch, he notices the mirror that Dryz was using, he gets up to place a piece of cloth and see's himself looking back at him, the reflection grows and fills the mirror. Grim looks away. and see's the hag in a window, see's her long fingers grabbing Koreck in the temple, Grim tries to attack her, but suddenly gets up from back in his bedroll. The hag is gone. the mirror is no longer there. it was all in his head. Grim covers all sources of reflection he can.
During Jaden's watch, Dryz dreams, he is in a blinding white cathedral floating above a tower of obsidian glass. the sky cracks sending a storm of tentacles made of starlight in void whispering truth and offer themselves to him, he accepts: "you are our favourite" it says, it's Dryz's voice, the magic is clean, a mirror rises, dryz see's himself smiling too wide, his mouth opens like a blooming flower, a tadpole comes out. there is something else watching, the tadpole wraps itself and fuses with dryz. glowing faintly Dryz's blood becomes cool and thick, each spell i've ever cast reverse itself, he feels a second brain behind, teling him he can change people against their will for their own good, he chooses to try and suppress it, he doesn't want to force this on others.
Jaden see's Dryz convulse and tries to wake him, Dryz succeeds in resisting against the tadpole and wakes up. Dryz goes back to sleep, Jaden and Grimgil discuss giving him nettie's potion.

item.title: Session 25 (Retreat)
item.description:
The party decides to head to bed in the inn, the kid Koreck
Dryz trained with Darius Veynar of the Crowns guard. Dryz is still missing details about his initial investigation of the Disappearing people in Drusburgh. Bow's behaviour of pulling his bow out has occurred previously
Dryz addresses the party and tells them about Elir's letter. it seems to all point to the witch in woods.
Jaden addresses Dryz about his investigations and now linking it with the witch in the woods, he thanks Dryz and feels like he's doing it for him, Dryz tells him that he's doing it for someone else more. "Brave little mice sneaking in the night, you've stolen something from me, I won't let thieves get away" "Little detective always prying, they're mine, what's stolen must be returned"
The hag talks to Dryz and Jaden in their heads, Koreck stirs and wakes up the rest of the party. Dryz inform the party of what the hag said, Grimgil wakes the Koreck to prevent her from talking through him. Grimgil see's the Hag's shadow out of the window.
Dryz casts locate creature on Old Mother Salt to make see if she is actually around or it's all an illusion. she pings at the location where the shadow came from, then disapears pretty quickly.
Jaden can't sleep, Dryz uses modify memory to help Jaden fall asleep and goes to bed.
During Eldil and Grim's watch everything is too silent, Eldil starts hearing crows and frogs the sounds become louder and swarming. Eldil casts silence to silence the noise
Grimgil goes to the window, there is a crow but no sounds can happen because of the silence.
ELdil hears "You think a prayer keeps me out, the gods left me long ago, only bargains something somethin".
Bow starts his watch, he resists the urge to take out his bow, the kid is missing and has been replaced with straw, Bow wakes up the Party, turns out it was all in his head.
As dryz falls back asleep she says "This is how it ends, first they vanish from your bed then your memory, right here in Drusburgh, ... sleep well detective, dream deep, ..."
Bow's watch ends without anymore incident. Koreck says he's never slep like that in ever. Dryz gives Jaden his memories back.
The party heads downstairs for the breakfast that was promised, the innkeeper is the one that is preparing the breakfast, her husband is gone she and Jaden does not remember him at all.
Dryz casts detect thoughts and dives as deep into her memories, he is gone, his things are still in his house and she just dismisses them. whenever she see's her husbands she feels sadness.
The rest of the party looks at the letter, only Eldil is able to see a phrase saying "it's eating us " on the letter.
The party heads to the temple of Selune to investigate if there is anyway that koreck can be safe there, and if the Hag can't afftect hallowed ground.
Lisandra Valora is the head priestess of the temple, Eldil heads to see her and have an audience with her. he discusses the disappearances, she mentions Darius Veynar was looking into it. she mentions a cleric that came in looking for someone, nobody knew who he was talking about, otherwise there's no other issues.
Dryz asks the priestess about the innkeepers husband and she remembers him, she only fairly rarely leaves the temple. The party asks the priestess to take care of Koreck and keep him on hallowed grounds to keep him safe. Jaden tells the kid to remain on the temple grounds and has a nice heart to heart.
Jaden gets looked at by a priest called Nyx, he can't get rid of Jaden's mark with a remove curse but it fails.
Jaden tell's us the hag is in the forest outside of Oakhurst.
Grimgil tries to talk to a bird about the surrounding forests. it says there is nothing off about the woods around here, they stay away from Drusburgh most of the time. they are rumours of birds never coming back from there.
The party encounters a lady selling carpets in the city, the carpets are all of the same person, but she does not know who it is "eyes in the earth" she says.
The party encounters a crew from the ship and they are looking for the quartermaster from the ship, Bow does not remember her, Dryz tries to tell her to leave Drusburgh, but it's not very convincing. Tessa went to the market to get food and supplies. Sticks and Stone, Water to Wine and Born in bread.
The party tries to retrace her steps to see what happened to her. she placed an order at the sticks and stones to be delivered to the valiant ember. Jaden steals a mirror. Eldil has to pay a high price for a mirror and a vendor is very hesitant to part with it. the party heads to the Water to Wine.
Eldil, Jaden and Grimgil start hearing some music, a new pothole is on the street Dryz and Bow can't see it and trip.
The Water and Wine had a letter to deliver the party tells them they are here to pick it up. the letter reads:
I don’t trust myself much longer. Writing it may be the only way it survives. Something is wrong in Drusburgh. I’ve lost track of the days, of the people… there are faces I know I should remember, but when I try, it’s as if the names dissolve on my tongue. Whole families gone, and no one speaks of it. When I ask, they stare at me like I’m mad—or worse, they pity me. And the singing… gods, the singing. At first faint, like a lullaby behind the walls, then stronger, as if the stones themselves hum with it. When it comes, my thoughts are no longer mine. Hours slip away. When the silence returns, something is missing. Always something. I fear I’m next. If I vanish, don’t let them call it sickness, or a sailor lost at sea. Search beneath the city, beneath the boards and the stones. Something feeds there, I swear it. If you still remember me after I’m gone, then follow the song. If you don’t… burn this letter, and may the gods preserve your mind. — Tessa
The party enter the city sewer, the music is faiter in the sewers, they follow the water down the sewer system, some of it has been damaged and collapsed, similar state of disrepair to the rest of the city.
There are leftover bones and remains in the sewers some humanoid some animals, they sometimes matches some of the potholes and damage. Eldil tries to taunt the hag, noises of fingers scratching on a chalkboard appear. they hag talks to Eldil and offers a bargain.
The party ends up in an open space with more corpses and looks like a nest, Grimgil casts alarm to attempt to catch. Dryz notices there are no live animals in the sewers. Eldil starts to hear the music in the sewers and tries to follow it. they decide to stay in the lair. slowly the music gets louder as they wait in the lair.
Grimgil makes a brew and gives everyone else resistance to poison and immunity to disease

item.title: Session 23
item.description:
The party is still on the Valient Amber sailing towards Drusburgh it is the 3rd night of their 4 day journey. A storm has been lingering for most of the journey. Noises of a fight ruffles the party up to the deck. Roll for initiative
The party fought a bunch of swagen? and then the boat got attacked by a kraken, most of the crew died, shadowheart and Astarion never helped. The party managed to hurt the kraken enough to get it to retreat but they barely escaped with their lives.

item.title: Session 22
item.description:
The party is at the inn in Frila ready for a long rest, Bow uses his fish staff to make a performance in the inn's aquarium, they have to wait until morning for Halsin to restore the mayors soul. Grimgil uses speak with animal and convinces the fishes to perform "under the see" from the little mermaid.
Eldil and Jaden head straight to the rooms, Grimgil barges in to Eldil's room. Eldil tries to hide his blindness. Grimgil investigates Eldil's old cursed axe, the eyes on the axe blink at the same time as Eldil.
The party tries all sorts of remedies to cure Eldil, but none of them work.
Jaden exits the inn and goes for a stroll, Grimgil attunes to his stick, now called the everburning club of embers.
Jaden enters the infirmary and approaches a nurse, asks for help curing curses to help Eldil, unfortunately no one in town can deal with curses.
Eldil fails to attune to his eye blade and remains blind. the axe is a jealous of the other axe and refuses to attune until he gets rid of it. Eldil blindly tries to throw the new axe out of the window but misses, Dryz comes in and offers to modify his memory to forget he ever cast away his original axe. he tries to attune again and it works. Dryz informs the rest of the party of the situation and that the party should find a way to remove curse so his memory can be restored.
Jaden buys a pipe and comes back to the inn, the party has a round of beers together, Vallen thorn joins them to give them a letter so Merrick thorn will take the party where they want from the harbour. The party takes a long rest. Some dreams occur, Jer was pissing so no notes.
The party wakes up without any other incident. they exit the inn and head over to the infirmary to wait for Halsin , but he is already there. they give him the soul stone and Halsin starts a ritual to restore the mayor's soul to his body, at the same time Grimgil ritually heals people in the infirmary. Halsin's ritual succeeds and the soul stone is destroyed. Nilas Orelian wakes up disoriented, but seems fine. the party leaves the mayor alone to discuss with vallen thorn. Halsin says goodbye and mentions that people will be waiting to talk to us at the harbour. the party heads out of town towards Black tide bay.
During the journey Grimgil casts aid and waterbreathing on the party, as they arrive, Eldil approaches people dismantling fortifications and asks who is in charge. Merrick thorn answers, and Eldil gives him the letter from Vallen thorn. He offers us a ride on the Valient Amber, his own ship, on route to Drusburgh, a city on Ardezax.
Merrick thorn, informs the party of people waiting for us, Jaden and the rest of the party approaches them. Shadowheart, Gale, and Astarion are the ones waiting for them.
Astarion wants to join and hitch a ride with the party on the Valient Amber, Shadowheart and Gale wants the same thing. The party doesn't object, they will join the trip on the Valient Amber.
Gale says he's been studying the tadpole problem, he's teleported to many places even outside of the island, and the tadpole problem is everywhere, he seems to believe they might all transform as a single event. Gale warns the party to be carful when they head to ardezax.
Gale explains the Netherese magic protecting the tadpole, a follower of mystra, named Karsus who developed a separate branch of magic and try to overthrow mystra and the weave. mystra tried to erase all Netherese magic but traces still exist.
The port workers ready the ship and the party heads out on the ship to Ardezax on a week long journey.
The party has discussion on the ship, Dryz reveals most of his backstory, omitting the true scale of the conspiracy he uncovered, they then discuss the plan once they get to Drusburgh. Eldil wants to move on immidiately to get to Baldur's Gate, he explains he wants to kill Manual, all he says he desrves it, he elaborates later. Manual is an old friend, they were basically brothers, Manual betrayed Eldil and his family.
Eldil, admits that Manual killed his parents, he explodes in a rage a triggers his radiant consumption accidentally
Jaden explains he grew up on the streets, never knew his family, he had to kill to eat. At some point he made friends with an old man who would give him bread, he eventually got work as a hunter,
Bow tells the party that he is from Ardezax and tells them about his dreams of his past life. he believes his father's name is Tharion Blackwood
Bow secretly deciphers a letter, the party is unaware of it.
The party does many shenanigans to scare the sailors on the boat to make them think it's haunted.

item.title: Session 19
item.description:
Bonus DM note: the symbol of Myrkul is an upright triangle with skull, the symbol of the absolute has an upside down triangle with a skull among other details.
Bow is feeling better starting to regain his memories, Grimgil guides the party back to Frila using his special druid abilities.
Grimgil casts speak with animals on a small bird, asks if it has seen Halsin as a giant eagle carrying the mayor, it has and points him in the right direction, the part follows him to an infirmary in the center of town. Grimgil approaches the passed out mayor and ritual casts detect magic on him.
Jaden asks Halsin how Nilas is doing, Nilas' wounds are not able to be closed by basic magical means.
Grimgil finishes his ritual, he feels conjuration and necromantic magic, Nilas is not poisoned or diseased. Dryzfrin buys a flute. The party heads to the last drop, a pub in Frila, and requests a room, they head in to the room to study the journal found in the cemetery mausoleum, Halsin is also there.
Jaden searches the book for ways to heal Nilas, in the Journal it contains Malkavor Ardin's ramblings about his life, the vibe changes suddenly into more magical and arcane writing. Grimgil detects no magic on the book. the arcane writing seems to be written in a different handwriting.
Halsin tells us to turn to page 5! for the ritual that was happening in the temple. All ingredients and steps for the ritual have been completed, at the bottom of the page it says "I can finally own his soul" in the writting of Malkavor Ardin probably speaking of Nilas. The ritual seems to be to seperate a soul from a body. One of the ingredients is a soul gem '(the party did not find any soul gems). On the last page of the journal is Malkavor Ardin's final goal, destroying Nilas' soul in the ethereal plane, this would open a portal for Myrkul to unleash death upon Frila.
Dryz looks for rituals in the book that helps to get to the etheareal plane, he finds that there is an area in the temple that might be a permanent anchor to the ethereal plane. Dryz's tadpole tells him that it could grant him the power to use the anchor.
Halsin notices that the insigna of the absolute is a combination of the symbol of The Dead Three.
Dryz and Jaden go back to see Nilas and cast detect thoughts, he is fully devoid of thoughts, clearly his soul is not in his body. The party heads to bed in the in pub.
Grimgil dreams of a dense primeval force, the force is alive with otherworldy energy, it is twisted and dark. whispers speak to Grimgil, guiding him to a clearing with a large tree and a skull at it's base. A deep voice calls: "Grimgil... Nature's Warriors". Tendrils grab Grimgil offering strength and power, animals enter the clearing ans kneel before him, he feels control over them. The animals are all deformed and have tentacles growing from them. the voice offers power again. reference's someone named "shuriken". the voice becomes a chorus and offers to take care of the mist.
Jaden dreams of a grand hall filled with mirrors, Jaden reaches two mirrors on a pedestal, one with the image of Toby and the other with the image of Clara. Toby is missing fingers and is the same age as the last time he saw him. there is a seat at the end of the hall, Jaden can feel a presence in the room but can't pinpoint what it is. the presence whispers to Jaden offering him to embrace his true nature, Jaden recognizes some of the features of the presence, he does not feel good. it whispers to Jaden "It is time to rejoin your proper ranks... there will be no sad stories like those of your friends". Jaden kneels before the image of Toby and places his hand on the mirror. Jaden asks the presence who it is, it does not answer, only says he must help and protect them do they can take over faerun. The images of Clara and Toby clear, Jaden see's a place where he was trapped in the mirrors before he wakes up.
Maybe something will happen to Eldil (Andre is absent).
Nothing else happens during the night the party wakes up in the pub. the innkeeper comes in and starts to prepare a breakfast. Grimgil goes to see Nilas and casts dispel magic on him, then casts detect magic, the conjuration magic is gone. Grimgil pulps up a goodberry and is about to feed it to Nilas, but guards stop him before he can. Finally, Grimgil cast healing word on Nilas and some of the wounds heal.
The party heads out of town back towards the crypt, the presence of undead is lower, the party runs to the crypt, roll for initiative.
The party evades the undead and manages to enter the chapel closing the door behind them.

item.title: Session 17
item.description:
The party is at the gates of Frila, the guards tells the party they should talk to Vallen Thorn to get information on the necromancer. The party heads towards city hall to talk to the investigators, the city looks destroyed, most homes are in disrepair, some are boarded up.
Grimgil speaks to one of the villagers (a lady with a beard because of the mist) she inform him that anytime after dusk and before down there is danger, people are going missing some coming back as zombies. It all started after goblins attacked the city. PS its canon that goblins have boobs
The area closer to city hall is less destroyed and better guarded. Eldil uses Divine sense outside of the town hall but finds nothing, the party enters the town hall and Eldil uses divine sense again. he senses something undead behind him and turns around, he sees an elf at the bottom of the stairs that appears undead.
Grimgil and Bow notice that the undead elf has a tadpole in his head. Eldil approaches him and attempts to grapple him, he succeeds and the elf calls for help, guards are starting to approach, Eldil starts attacking him. Roll for imitative.
Dryz suggests to the Elf that he reveals his true nature and surrenders to the guards, he tells the guards he is Astarion, an Elf from Baldur's Gate, they arrest Eldil because he attacked the elf, Eldil continues to try and escape and reveal his undeadness. chaos ensues.
Bow talks in the head of Astarion, he believes the party are assassins sent by Cazador, the party informs him this is not the case.
In the end, Eldil is dragged to the jail, Grimgil escaped as a horse, Jaden, Bow and Dryz follow willingly to the jail, they wait for Vallen Thorn to discuss what happened. Vallen Thorn does not Believe Eldil, informs the party that Astarion has been helping them for the few weeks. Bow asks him about the other problems in town, but he is unwilling to share any details after the ordeal. Eldil needs to stay in the cell for the night.
Vallen Thorn tells us that Malkavor Ardin is the necromancer we are looking for. Dryz asks to stay the night so he can keep an eye on Eldil. Vallen Thorn explains that nobody has return when investigating the town crypt, every time people leave town they don't return.
Jaden and Bow, spend the rest of the day investigating in the town, Grimgil finds bum circles to gather information, there was another attack last night so there shouldn't be any attacks for a few days.
During the night Dryz notices a shadow in the jail, but it leaves as soon as he makes a sound, Bow gets sneakily grappled by Astarion and he starts interrogating Bow about why they attacked them. Astarion asks if the party came from the ship, he explains that he was also from the ship, he ran straight to Frila. Bow compares Astarion to Eldil, Astarion says he has a gift for him. item.title: Drusburgh
item.description:
A merchant and shipping city on the continent of Ardezax, reached by sea from Black Tide Bay on Longtooth Island. The party sailed here aboard the Valient Amber.[1] They found the city in a bad state — decaying and unsettled, its streets pocked with potholes and cave-ins.[2] The decay mirrored what festered below: a False Hydra nesting in the sewers, whose song erased the memory of everyone it devoured, so whole families vanished and no one could recall them. The party tracked and killed it.[3]
It is also the city where Dryz trained as an investigator with the Crowns guard, and where his friend Elir died.
Home to the Crowns guard, whose Darius Veynar looked into the vanishings and later rewarded the party for the hydra. The Iron accord keeps archives here; Thomas Aquinous helped the party research how to kill a hag.[4] The Artisan's guild of Ardezax is headquartered in the city and holds unofficial sway over its docks and export pricing.
A temple of Selûne stands in the city, led by head priestess Lisandra Valora with the priest Nyx. Its hallowed ground was used to shelter the child Koreck from Old Mother Salt.[5]
A collapsing sewer network beneath the city, littered with humanoid and animal bones. The False Hydra denned in an open, corpse-strewn nest here; the party noticed there were no living animals anywhere in the tunnels.[6]
A quartermaster, Tessa, vanished after leaving a warning letter with a market vendor before the hydra took her.[7] Vendors also traffic uneasy mirrors tied to Old Mother Salt, whose separate meddling left salt at the scenes of missing children.[8]

item.title: The Absolute
item.description:
The Absolute is the god-like power worshipped by the cult spreading across Longtooth Island. The goblins and goblinoids of the island serve it, having abandoned their old god Maglubiyet for it, and its cult is behind the occupation of Celadon, the games in Trixie, and the attempt to summon Igarok.

The party first learned this from a vision near the Fishing Camp outside Celadon.[1] They were later named by the acolyte Glimmerfang the Wicked as Orin, Aldric Stormborn — king of Ardezax — and Ketheric Thorm.[2] Its insignia combines the symbols of the Dead Three, an inverted skull-and-triangle.[3]

Halsin suspects the cult and the tadpole infestation are linked, the parasite being wrapped in the Netherese magic its rise accompanies.[7]

item.title: False Hydra
item.description:
The False Hydra was a memory-eating creature that nested in the sewers beneath Drusburgh, the source of the city's vanishing people. Its song erased all memory of those it devoured, so that whole families disappeared and no one could recall they had ever existed. The party hunted and killed it during their time in Drusburgh.
The False Hydra feeds unseen: its droning "singing" — first a faint lullaby behind the walls, then a hum in the very stones — overwrites the minds of those who hear it, deleting the memory of each victim it takes. Townsfolk stared blankly at anyone who asked after the missing, as if the names had dissolved on their tongues. Tessa, a ship's quartermaster, recorded the phenomenon in a warning letter before she herself was taken, urging the party to "search beneath the city… something feeds there" and to "follow the song."[1]
It denned in the damaged, collapsing sewers under Drusburgh, a state of disrepair that mirrored the decay of the city above. The tunnels were littered with humanoid and animal bones, and the potholes and cave-ins in the streets matched the remains below. The party tracked the music to an open nest strewn with corpses, where they noticed there were no living animals anywhere in the sewers.[2]
Even in its lair the creature clouded the party's minds — they briefly forgot why they had come. When it finally emerged they fought and killed it. With the False Hydra dead, its hold on the town broke and the forgotten dead were remembered at last; the meddling of Old Mother Salt proved to be a separate matter.[3] Returning to the surface, the townsfolk were struck with grief as they realized how many people they had forgotten.
Eldil severed several of the creature's heads as proof. Strangely, Dryzfrin was able to recover six tadpoles from inside them, tying the monster to the wider illithid infestation.[4] The party brought the heads to Darius Veynar of the Crowns guard to claim a reward and to report what they had learned of the creature, the still-missing children, and the witch possibly linked to them.

item.title: The Tadpole
item.description:
The illithid tadpole is the parasite implanted in each member of The Party aboard the Crashed Nautiloid, and the object the whole campaign is named for. Rather than triggering the usual rapid ceremorphosis into a mind flayer, these tadpoles behave abnormally: they linger, communicate with their hosts, and offer power instead of immediately consuming them.
The party was infected while captive on the Crashed Nautiloid, waking with the parasites already in their heads.[1] The ship's artifact and the presence of allied intellect devourers suggest the tadpoles were engineered for a purpose beyond ordinary illithid reproduction.
Unlike a normal infection, these tadpoles do not quickly transform their hosts. Halsin examines the party and notes the tadpole is "not normal" and is surrounded by Netherese magic, a forbidden branch of the weave created by Karsus and outlawed by Mystra.[2] Gale later confirms the tadpole problem is widespread far beyond Longtooth Island, and suspects every host may be meant to transform together in a single event.[3] The Netherese enchantment protecting the parasite ties it directly to the plot of the Absolute.
The tadpole speaks to its host in dreams, offering strength, "vengeance," and new abilities in exchange for acceptance or for consuming additional tadpoles. Nearly every member of The Party has been tempted this way:
Eldil repeatedly eats tadpoles he finds and hides them from the group, guided by a voice urging "one of us, one of us."[4]
Dryzfrin is offered powers such as Horrific Visage and, later, the ability to bend others' wills "for their own good," which he chooses to suppress.[5]
Jaden and Grimgil are marked in their flesh and offered "true tongue of the wild" and dominion over deformed, tentacled beasts.[6] Accepting the offers grants real power but advances the host toward ceremorphosis.
Ceremorphosis is the process by which a tadpole consumes and rewrites its host into a mind flayer: the body is remade, memories are erased and replaced with mind-flayer thought, and the newborn illithid answers the call of an elder brain. The party has seen the result in the mind flayers dug from the ground near the Crashed Nautiloid, and in Benjamin Caldwell, a Celadon survivor who collapsed and sprouted tentacles days after his rescue — "a classic type of ceremorphosis."[7] Because the party's parasites are abnormal (see Abnormal Nature above), their own transformation has been delayed — something even Halsin finds strange.[8] The threat is dramatized in Eldil's nightmare, in which he undergoes full ceremorphosis — skin greying, memories dissolving, hearing the elder brain — and wakes with white eyes and a missing fingernail.[9]
Hosts of these special tadpoles are recognized by the Absolute's cult as True Souls. Minthara and other cultists urge the party to "turn to the Absolute" and stop resisting, treating them as chosen rather than as prey.[10] Grimgil is identified as a True Soul early on and reported as such to Celadon.[11]Two possible cures have been raised:
A Zaith'isk at the nearby Gith Crèche, a githyanki device said to remove tadpoles.[12]
Nettie provides vials meant to be drunk if a host begins to visibly transform.[13]

item.description:
Home continent of Dryz and Jaden

Cultural facts : Ardezax is under the governance of King Aldric Stormborn. There are different organized groups in Ardezax : The Artisan’s guild : mainly managed by the smaller folks, the crafters and the gatherers. The dwarves, the gnomes and the halflings work together to manage this guild. A proud coalition of crafters, thinkers, gatherers and traders. The Artisan’s guild is the economic backbone of Ardezax. Built on mutual profit and shared labor, they have pooled their talents to dominate the market on creation, logistics and creative acquisitions. It is used by many for contracts to craft, gather resources, enchant and sometimes to guard merchant roads especially when their goods are involved. The Halflings will also be willing to do other kinds of work, if you are discreet and willing to pay well. They take side jobs (or black market contracts) where theft can be involved from time to time where they will call it instead “borrowing”, even though they don’t intend to bring back the things stolen. Their headquarters, The Hands of Coin and Craft, is in Drusburgh, one of the main cities where merchants come in to eventually get to Bruxar. They hold an unofficial control over docks, loading and export pricing in Drusburgh and Caldaren. The different ranks in the guild are as follow : apprentice (learning the trades, mostly gatherers), journeyman (handle the basic contracts while still perfectioning their methods), master artisan (proven creators and experienced merchants), the Guildtable (council of veteran master artisans who vote on trade alliances, high contracts and political implications), The Coinwright (guildmaster who oversees the treasury and is the principal negotiator between the guild and the different cities of Ardezax. The present Coinwright is Brynna Coppervein, a third generation metalsmith and a ledger-mancer (magical accountant). She climbed the ranks not by brute force but by outsmarting her rivals and stabilizing guild finances. There is a clear pact between the Artisan’s guild and the Iron Accord for mutual protection and production contracts. Emblem (brass colored) : A hammer, a quill and a sickle arranged in a circle surrounded by a gear-shaped border with a flame in the center.
The Gilded Fangs : mainly managed by the less trusted races : goblins, hobgoblins, bugbears, orcs and kobolds. They are opportunistic muscle-for-hire with a focus on intimidation, coercion and “enforcement” rather than crime. They aren’t stealthy like the Underbelly, but they aren’t savages either. They are disciplined enough to be useful. The types of job they tend to prefer are debt collecting, blackmailing, “hostile negotiations”, sabotage, smash and grab raids or transport missions with questionable objects or individuals. Their headquarters, the Scrapclaw Hold, is located in Caldaren, being to the north of the country and having less inquisitions than the other cities of Ardezax. Their ranks are as follows : Recruits, Fangsmen (can lead small missions), Goldlords (take care of the necessary bribing of the guards and political manipulation), The Maw (guild leader). To become The Maw, one must win a blood duel. The current Maw is Thargoz the Reforged, a hob-goblin veteran who was left for dead by the Iron Accord and returned with a steel jaw. The Gilded Fangs code is Fangs First; No coin, no cause; and The strong lead. Emblem : A golden serpent coiled around a coin with a ruby studded fang piercing through the coin. The serpent represents cunning, greed and danger; the coin shows ambition to rule through wealth and their ruthless pursuit of gold; and the ruby evokes wealth and blood, suggesting that riches are paid for in violence.The Iron Accord : their composition is truly diverse : humans, half-elves, elves, tieflings, dragonborns, dwarves, tabaxi, etc. All that matters in the Iron Accord is skill. They are a professional mercenary organization, transparent and honorable to their contracts while being efficient. They offer military support for city-states or factions, they offer guards and escort missions, bounty hunting and monster hunting, they truly are a neutral force for peacekeeping. The guild is structured with ranks : Oathbrands (members), Pactwardens (officers), Commandant and The Iron Voice (guildmaster)). The current Iron voice is Marshal Caelan Virellian, a human, former battlefield commander who believes in order, honor and contracts. He isn’t naïve, he knows that ideals don’t win wars but that discipline and leverage do. He now carries a war ledger instead of a sword, leaving the fighting to the new generations and he has a steel coin on his desk reminding him that every decision has two faces. They work with mission delegations and they have their own arbitration council to prevent double-dealings, betrayals of contracts, no targeting civilians and the assurance of being paid. Their headquarters is called Hammerpost in Bruxar. Along their walls, there are plaques to honor their fallen. Emblem (steel gray coloured) : A towering shield crossed by two iron gauntlets. The shield represents protection, contract enforcement and the gauntlets represent discipline, strength and unity.The Crown’s guards : The main militia force of the continent. They make up the guards of every city and manage the dungeons.The Underbelly : They keep mostly to themselves and their “guild” is an association only spoken of in rumors. The rumors say that they are a guild meant for the darker jobs or jobs related to the Underdark, assassination, kidnapping, extortion, torture, theft being the lighter part of their activities.

item.title: Tessa
item.description:
Quartermaster from the Valient Amber who went missing in Drusburgh and left a letter for the party,
I don’t trust myself much longer. Writing it may be the only way it survives. Something is wrong in Drusburgh. I’ve lost track of the days, of the people… there are faces I know I should remember, but when I try, it’s as if the names dissolve on my tongue. Whole families gone, and no one speaks of it. When I ask, they stare at me like I’m mad—or worse, they pity me. And the singing… gods, the singing. At first faint, like a lullaby behind the walls, then stronger, as if the stones themselves hum with it. When it comes, my thoughts are no longer mine. Hours slip away. When the silence returns, something is missing. Always something. I fear I’m next. If I vanish, don’t let them call it sickness, or a sailor lost at sea. Search beneath the city, beneath the boards and the stones. Something feeds there, I swear it. If you still remember me after I’m gone, then follow the song. If you don’t… burn this letter, and may the gods preserve your mind. — Tessa

item.title: Elir
item.description:
Dryz's dead friend, the catalyst that made him become an investigator.She sent them the following letter before dying:
Dear Drizfryn, I don’t know if you’ve noticed, but Drusburgh feels… thinner these days. People vanish — not in a sudden way, but in a quiet way, as if the world simply forgets to hold them. A house on Market Row stood full last season; now it sits empty, shutters swaying, and no one speaks of where its owners have gone. It’s the same in the harbor — fewer hands on the ships, fewer voices at the tavern, though no one remarks upon it. Perhaps it’s nothing. Perhaps I’m only growing paranoid. Still, I thought it worth writing down before the feeling slips from me. I’ll be going to Drusburgh to investigate more about this. Meet me on the 2nd of the 8th month at dawn. Yours, Elir.
Edlil notices that the letter also says "It's eating us" at some part of the letter, erased by the hag for all others

item.title: Session 11
item.description:
Jeaden had a dream. Eldil had a pleasant dream about his family love which turned into a nightmare.
Players started their journey towards Trixie. At the first sight of the vast lands around Trixie, Grimgil notices for the first time a barren, burning, wasteland. This region used to be filled with trees and life. Good for hunting, hiding and trapping. Is now being actively destroyed and burned (imagine Isengard). The little vegetation left seems scattered and tattered.
Along the way, they got attacked by 4 spectral goblins. Eldil got possessed which made him eventually feel hopeless and consume the other tadpole.
On the final night, Jeaden had a talk with Dryzfrin about the Absolute’s symbol where he managed to draw a copy.
They finally made it to Trixie.
Once at Trixie, the players offered themselves to the gladiatorial games inside the coliseum of Chaos They were instantly taken under the coliseum inside a prison for the contestants They learned that if they won the games they could win their freedom inside the city
They also met Halsin for the first time
Halsin informed the players of the reason for the cutting of trees in the region. The goblins are trying to summon an old legend called Igarok. A monster said to be able to control Mount Dalgan’s volcano.
Players also met Blorg for the 2nd time, who contested in the games with Halsin.
Players rose up to the first challenge and when they got inside the coliseum, it was decided that Ragnar the beast master would be the first opponent of Grimgil and his allies
After the first round won, players went back to their cells for the rest of the day, where they noticed a lot less contestants came back.

item.title: Session 10
item.description:
Jaden quickly looted a few things from the barracks (rope and a grappling hook and he took a flag hanging outside) They then left to go rest in the first outside of town again When they got to the sewer exit, they heard a horn sounding from the inner village During that evening Grimgil and Eldil had a heart to heart moment of bonding. On the next day, Grimgil scouted Celadon with a wild shape bird spirit. He saw that almost all the goblins had left, but there were more goblins corpses than what they had left behind. Signs of a struggle happened while the goblins were leaving the town.
Players understood that with the current head of the Absolute cut off, some goblins tried to revolt. Players make their way inside Celadon to find maps and documents. They head to the Town Hall and find a world map and 4 remaining prisoners unconscious. After healing the prisoners, they got some info from the mayor of Celadon, M. Theodore Kesington. The other prisoners were his wife Evelyn Kesington, and 2 other residents of Celadon, Benjamin Caldwell and another young man whom Theodore forgot his name. Jaden made a big soup in front of the Temple while Theodore went to fetch his last remaining magic items that were hidden in the nobles quarters and the Temple (a +1 longbow and +1 Bloodwell vial). The players then left the 4 civilians telling them to go to Sylvanus Grove and bring back the other civilians. Informing them also that the goblin threat is lifted for now. With the world map, players found out every known location of Toril. They also found that they were on an island called Longtooth Island which is located southwest of Ardezax. Ardezax being another bigger island off the coast of Faerûn. The players then left to head towards Trixie, marching out of Celadon through the north and choosing to cross the river towards mount Dalgan. After a really good bonding moment with all the players, telling each other where they are from, they decided to turn in the night. During Eldil’s watch, the 1st watch, they had lit 4 fires and Eldil was playing the flute making it easy for them to be found by Benjamin Caldwell.
Benjamin made his way to Eldil, not feeling well. Falling before him, he started transforming into a mind flayer, the ceremorphosis being complete. Players then fought a mind flayer who tried to convince/recruit Eldil since he had made such good progress with the Absolute. During the encounter, players saw what the mind flayers power was capable of and saw two-headed crocodiles with small tentacles sprouting from their bodies come out of the river. After they proceeded to kill the mindflayer and the crocodiles. Eldil then proceeded to collect another tadpole. This is where the session ended.

item.description:
Players looted the ogres. They had a long rest.
The next day they headed north towards Celadon. Along the way they met goblins who had set a trap for them along the road.
After defeating the goblins, players headed to the gate of Celadon. When they got there, They decided to try and force the boss of the goblins out of the gate to talk with them.
When the goblins refused because they were scared of the ravage the players had produced, the players killed more goblins on top of the wall before retreating to the nearby forests.
They then proceeded to wait 2 hours and went back to the gate with Grimgil being a spider in - Jaden’s pocket and having Bow and Dryzfrin following them close by invisible. They left Eldil in the woods nearby telling him to wait for them to open the gates.
After deceiving their way inside pretending to be a dead goblin from the “ambush team”, they were met with a squadron of goblins and a hobgoblin who wanted to interrogate Jaden who was a goblin supposedly dead.
Being led by 6 goblins and Dror Ragzlin, the hobgoblin, inside the inner city and taken into the nearest building inside for interrogation, Grimgil decided to step out and try to run inside a corner of the house. Being spotted as a hand sized spider, the goblins squashed him and discovered Grimgil. Grimgil then fled into the sewer system of the city as a rat, but remained nearby. Jaden then tried to deceive the goblins again by trying to run outside to “help” them catch Grimgil and by doing so evaded a grapple of Dror. He then immediately made a rope trick 3 feet from the ground and hid in it.
While this was happening, Dryzfrin and Bow tried to follow the players whilst staying in nearby alleyways. Their scent being picked up by wargs, they hid in the sewer system of the city. Trying to make their way through the sewer system all the way to the inner city until they learned of Grimgil’s misfortune and Jaden’s sudden disappearance from the telepathic connection they had, Dryzfrin stepped into action. Teleporting himself on top of the inner city wall and jumping down trying to help his friend. He got caught alone and, while unconscious, got dragged to the inner city’s prison. Finally, Bow, trying to catch up to Dryzfrin, made the jump on top of the inner city’s wall. Jumped down still invisible, got tangled inside a wild growth spell that Grimgil did to try and help limit the enemies movement. Bow’s scent got picked up by the 2 wards on the inside of the inner wall, and he’s now fighting for his life.
Lastly, Jaden finally popped his head out of his rope trick to communicate with his friends. He’s now hiding in the nearby thick grass caused by the wild growth spell.
